candidates.change_summary: Change the require condition from msg.value == 10 ether to msg.value == 0 ether so fallback can be called without ether, altering the balance transfer behavior.
Delete the require statement for msg.value == 10 ether so fallback can be called with any msg.value, changing when the balance transfer can occur.
Delete the require statement for block.timestamp > pastBlockTime so fallback can be called multiple times in the same block, changing the balance transfer frequency.
Change block.number % 15 == 0 to block.number % 15 != 0, reversing the condition under which the balance is transferred.
Change block.number % 15 == 0 to block.timestamp % 15 == 0, modifying the condition for balance transfer from block-based to time-based.
Move pastBlockTime = block.timestamp before the second require so the timestamp check uses the updated value, allowing repeated calls in the same block.
Delete the if block that transfers the balance, so the fallback never transfers funds.
